tool_calls.arguments: {"summary": "I fixed `slugify` in `src/slug.js`, and `npm test` now passes (1 of 1; before the change it failed).\n\nThe bug was in the separator. `slugify` replaced each run of non-alphanumeric characters with `_` instead of `-`. That made `'Hello World'` come out as `hello_world`. It also meant the last step, which strips leading and trailing `-`, had nothing to strip, so a string like `\" Hi! \"` would have kept a trailing `_`. Changing the replacement to `-` fixes both."}
